lessons_used: Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path decision helper, restore assurance), single-click and card carousel layouts, hotkey shortcut copy, and interactive waiting status updates consistently yield significant wins.

Harmful changes: Complex flow overhauls (docking setup, placement readiness check), intrusive split view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens lead to performance drops or early test terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, incentive badges, and background completion notifications repeatedly show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large positive predictions (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative results.

Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially hotkey shortcut copy, account identity/security hints, and interactive waiting status updates—frequently exceed low or negative initial predictions.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Trait Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion pick screen into a carousel focused on key traits and preview cards to speed up decision-making.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.7% with a median time of 89s, showing strong hesitation during pet pick.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0]': a badge cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a new post-waiting screen detailing primary hotkeys and visibility controls before entering the main desktop view.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding pets not showing up on desktop or users not knowing how to control or hide them.

new_desktop_controls.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_controls.body: Use hotkeys or system tray to summon, hide, or talk to your companion anytime.

components.text: Press Alt+Pet to bring your pet to the front

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Rebuild the path selection screen with a two-column layout explicitly contrasting instant companion pick versus custom creation.
candidates.why: choose_path has a very high mean completion time of 514s, indicating confusion between available paths.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Pet Preservation Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the sign-in screen using a card layout emphasizing account data safety and automatic pet preservation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint explaining that signing in automatically links and restores previously created pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets disappearing or resetting after sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs and restores your previously adopted desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adding a hint explaining account synchronization on the sign-in screen complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Top support issue; restore assurance hints are proven high-confidence wins.

candidates.title: Pet Awakening Trait Status Updates
candidates.change: Show step-by-step pet assembly stage indicators on the waiting screen while background generation finishes.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) causing users to lose track of progress.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators on the waiting screen preserves its function and respects wait info rules.

candidates.score_note: High home wait duration; interactive waiting status updates consistently yield strong wins.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Summon Copy Update
candidates.change: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to summon, locate, and hide the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Users wrote in asking how to reveal pets that failed to show up on the screen or how to control them.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your pet near the system tray. Click or use hotkey Alt+P to summon or hide them.

guard.reason: Updating text on the home_intro screen inside onboarding complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Desktop summon copy/hotkey hints show solid positive lift and are cheap to implement.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Clarity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit lighting and subject framing advice to the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.

upload_photos.hint: Use a clear photo with good lighting and a single focused subject for best generation results.

guard.reason: Adding helpful photography guidance hints to the photo upload screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck; photo lighting hints are explicit historical winners.

candidates.change: Update the adoption certificate headline to clarify that pet names and attributes can be modified anytime post-onboarding.
candidates.why: Adoption median duration is 89s with a 66.7% completion rate, indicating hesitation over final choices.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name Your Companion (Editable Anytime)
adoption_certificate.body: Give your pet a starter name. You can update names and traits whenever you want.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the adoption certificate maintains its core purpose and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the 66.7% adoption bottleneck with reassurance copy, though adoption copy overall has mixed historical results.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Audio Alert Cue
candidates.change: Enable optional desktop ready notification and chime on completion during pet waiting time.
candidates.why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to tab away before pet generation finishes.

waiting.hint: We will play a sound and alert your desktop when your companion is ready.

guard.reason: Enabling waiting screen audio and desktop alert notifications is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Background completion notifications historically show no clear effect.

decisions.title: Home Intro Desktop Summon Copy Update

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Flow reordering, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path helper, account restore/security), single-click and card carousel layouts, hotkey shortcut copy, and interactive waiting status updates reliably yield significant wins.

Harmful changes: Complex setup or placement flow overhauls, intrusive split-view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, pick friend redesigns, and cheat sheet screens lead to performance drops or early terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, background completion notifications, and incentive badges consistently show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Predictions of +8.0% or higher consistently overestimate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative outcomes.
Predictions too low: Shortcut hotkey copy, account security and identity hints, and interactive waiting status updates frequently outperform negative or low initial predictions.
